capabilities: expand typed triggers into Markdown text on space
search and insert snippets from a picker
install community snippet packs in one click
import snippets from Text Snippets and Espanso
disambiguation: Not a template engine; it does plain text expansion only, and points users needing JavaScript, dynamic templates or tab stops to Templater.
extras: Only feature is text expansion by design; README documents limits (no regex triggers, no tab stops), a Wayland workaround, a colon-separator fix for emoji triggers, and states it goes online only to fetch the pack catalog from GitHub.
intentEvidence: Espanso, Raycast, Keyboard Maestro and AutoHotkey work in every app, and Snipsy works only in Obsidian.
problem: Typing repeated Markdown and phrases by hand is slow, and system-wide expanders don't know Markdown, fire on pastes, or carry your snippets into Obsidian on mobile.

relations.evidence: On the Packages page, press Import under Text Snippets import.
JavaScript or dynamic templates: use Templater.
Regex triggers, or replacing text inside a word (y^2 into y²): use Substitutions.

summary: Text expander that turns short typed triggers into Markdown text as you write, with a snippet picker, pack installs, and imports from Text Snippets and Espanso.
